title: Project Scaffolding with TanStack Start + Bun
description: Initialize the project with TanStack Start and Bun runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Run `bun create @tanstack/start songscript-app` or equivalent to scaffold project
Move scaffolded files to project root (not nested in songscript-app/)
Update `package.json` scripts (note: `bun --bun` caused issues, using plain vite commands)
Verify `bun dev` starts the server on localhost:3001
Typecheck passes (`bun run typecheck` or equivalent)
